levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك

notes: «عن أبيه، قال سمعت أبي كعب بن مالك» : «أبي» with a name is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7), so «كعب بن مالك» is the Companion
«أبيه» with no name is a bare relation (Abd al-Rahman's father)
The saying is Ka'b's own account, carried by the chain: no ruling needed
